skills.generationPrompt: Build 섬광 일섬 with one connected long silver katana-like sword, black grip and small gold guard, pointing strictly right in every visible frame. F05 only a 10px white glint at P0=(18%,52%). F06-F09 reveal the right-facing sword with a thin compressed ivory wake behind its left-side pommel. F10-F12 translate the same sword rapidly rightward along y=52% without target, loose particles or contact light. F13 the rightmost blade tip first touches a compact vertical pearl-steel seal at P=(78%,52%). F14 compresses it forward. F15 splits the seal into two unequal pale plates with a razor-thin horizontal white flash continuing to the right. F16 holds the same right-facing sword through the split at reduced energy. At no time may the blade point left or the grip appear on the right.
